name: Turntide Islands Founding Knowledge Vault
customer: People who need source-grounded climate, technology, culture, and institutional memory without losing the working context to Discord scrollback.
problemEvidence: The live guild has 19 human members and nine distinct recent participants in mainland.
Members ask how prior research and analytical methods worked while the supporting notes and source trails remain difficult to retrieve.
The existing member vault lanes are empty even though TTI already declares a Vault Keeper, archive desk, receipts lane, and vault-backed briefings product surface.

offer.promise: A maintained, source-traceable knowledge vault that converts useful TTI conversation and Union/corpus research into briefings, reading paths, retrieval responses, and durable provenance.
included: At least one source-traceable vault briefing each week while the founding product is operated
A pooled member request desk for retrieval questions and reading-path requests
Durable rescue of selected Discord knowledge with source and access provenance
A receipts lane showing product status, observed revenue, known costs, and unknown costs
excluded: Personalized medical, legal, financial, safety, or emergency advice
A guaranteed response to every individual request or a private consulting SLA
Publication of member-private material outside its intended access boundary
Access to source material TTI is not authorized to redistribute

roles.rule: The historical islander role preserves founding access and is never evidence of payment; only a TTI-admitted settled entitlement may grant vault subscriber.

conversion.qualifiedCheckoutIntent: While payments are not admitted, one affirmative invitation POST records no-charge purchase interest at the exact candidate price and never contacts the payment provider.

commercial.providerOfferIngress: POST /membership/payment-provider/offer using a dedicated provider contract token and application/activity+json
commercial.providerOfferAdmission: An authenticated, self-content-addressed, unexpired offer can only become qualified-for-test after its ten bounded claims, evidence references, and USD 1 maximum provider-cost quote pass. Live operational admission separately requires seven self-addressed TTI-observed test receipts covering all ten requirements.

providerCostCeilingHypothesis.basis: successfully settled subscriber-month including payment processing and provider service

activationBlockers: TTI-to-provider customer contract token and provider-to-TTI receipt token
Provider catalog activation of this exact fixed USD 5 P1M subscription offering
Provider receipts for initial checkout, paid renewal, payment failure, cancellation, refund, and dispute lifecycle
Provider-authored service offer and attributable-cost quote at or below the candidate cost ceiling, followed by seven passing customer-observed operational test receipts
Dedicated provider-offer contract token and authenticated offer delivery

measurement.customerSignal: Reaction counts excluding the bot's seeded reactions
measurement.conversion: Settled TTI entitlement receipts divided by distinct qualified interest actors
measurement.fulfillment: Weekly briefings and admitted retrieval responses with publication receipts
measurement.economics: Externally receipted revenue minus attributable receipted costs; unknown costs remain unknown
